article.title: Cars out, weapons in at Volkswagen’s Osnabrück factory
article.author: Editor
article.content: Volkswagen’s plant in Osnabrück, Germany, is running out of cars. Weapons production is moving in. The post Cars out, weapons in at Volkswagen’s Osnabrück factory appeared first on MR Online .
